name: Treat
duplicates: built inside Inspection — see inspection / health-record

screens.name: The marked set · select and treat

notes.purpose: Filter the walk to marked pigs, tick them all and open Treatment.
rules: The mark made a set; the existing treat and move machinery drains it. No dedicated execution screen anywhere.

notes.purpose: The treatment form for the selection.

elements.name: Dose
elements.logic: The total (dose x pigs) shows only as the footnote on the commit, never as a field.
elements.rule: Required, with unit. One field, per pig.

elements.name: Treating for
elements.shows: The conditions being treated, read back by name
elements.rule: Absent (not empty) when nothing is open on the selection: prophylaxis is legal.

edge: Treating healthy pigs with no target is allowed.

notes.purpose: Choose which of the open conditions this treatment is for.

elements.name: Target row
elements.shows: A condition carried by some of the selected pigs

states.when: Union of open cases across the selection
states.shows: "fever · 4 of 6": the drug goes to all six, the fever link only to its four

elements.logic: The list is the union of the selection's open conditions; the fraction says who carries it. No pig gets a case link she does not have.

edge: Production's "no symptom recorded" empty-state screen is replaced by the absent-field rule.

notes.purpose: The walk the day after: the trail replaces the pending dot.

elements.name: What prints
elements.shows: The walk the day after: the trail replaces the pending dot.

states.shows: Pending dot replaced by "treated 1d"; each case keeps aging on its own
Red dot stands: discharged by the move, not by the drug; the move list still carries it
